ROOT.scriptdef:
update cdn.travat set trv_kntnumer=trn_kntnumer,trv_knanumer=trn_knanumer from cdn.travat join cdn.tranag on trn_gidtyp=trv_gidtyp and trn_gidnumer=trv_gidnumer where trv_gidtyp not in(1617,1625,1616,1624,1600,1603,1604,2003,2004,2039,2047,1232)
UPDATE cdn.TraVat SET TrV_KntNumer = CASE WHEN SaN_GIDTyp = /*Typ_SAD*/ 3376 THEN SaN_DstNumer ELSE SaN_KntNumer END , TrV_KnANumer = CASE WHEN SaN_GIDTyp = /*Typ_SAD*/ 3376 THEN SaN_DstAdres ELSE SaN_KnANumer END FROM cdn.TraVat INNER JOIN cdn.SadNag ON SaN_GIDTyp = TrV_GIDTyp and SaN_GIDNumer = TrV_GIDNumer WHERE TrV_GIDTyp IN (/*Typ_SAD*/ 3376, /*Typ_FWZ*/ 3378, /*Typ_FKZ*/ 3386, /*Typ_FWS*/ 3379, /*Typ_FKS*/ 3387)
